errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 10 000, като са показани само стойностите 0, 20 000, 40 000.
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis labels are at intervals of 10,000, but the visible labels (0, 20,000, 40,000) are at intervals of 20,000.
The phrasing "the units are in the dimension 'recall'" is awkward and redundant. 'Recall' is the quantity being measured, not a unit itself.
The description fails to mention that both lines are dashed and use circular markers, which was explicitly requested by the generation prompt.
The description omits the "(tf-idf)" part of the legend label for the 'sparse lexical representation' series.

errors.text_span: Синьо оцветената линия започва от малко под 0.7
errors.evidence: The description states the blue line starts slightly below 0.7, but the figure clearly shows the first data point is above 0.7, at approximately 0.72.

The phrase "after which the decrease becomes sharper" is an interpretation of the rate of change, which the prompt instructs to avoid. A more objective description would state the values at different points.

errors.text_span: Оранжево оцветената линия започва от малко над 0.05

The x-axis range does not extend over 50,000; the last data point is just under 50,000 and the last tick mark is at 40,000.

The orange line is dashed ('gestrichelt'), not dotted ('gepunktet').
